name: Yoshimine Yayoi
source:
Wakaba's lover and boss.
She is a young sales manager, and boasts of her ability as a sales manager,
She is popular among both men and women for her good looks and ability to do her job.
He was Wakaba's trainee until a year ago, when he confessed his love to her and they now live together.
